title: Reflection of finite local constancy by comparison
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and G an etale sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on X. If $\nu$_X^*G has finite constant models on a pro-etale covering family, then G is a finite locally constant etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].

source.place: Tags 099Y and 09AK; fixed-module coefficients and finite global stratifications

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-local-constancy] the comparison image is locally constant in slice sites. By [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-stalks] its geometric stalks are finite, so it is lisse.

Apply lisse-origin comparison [lem-sf-proetale-locally-constant-origin] to obtain a finite locally constant etale H whose comparison image is isomorphic to that of G. Full faithfulness [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level] lifts this isomorphism to H≅G; finite local constancy is invariant under isomorphism.

theorem isFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf_of_comparison_finite_models
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hG : ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (((g i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj
            ((ν^*(X)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj G) ≅
              (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G
